name: Walt Szymanski

statedReqs.notes: Ran a cabinet shop out of bay one for thirty years and rented the other three. Knows every tenant's kids' names. Wants it done right more than done fast.

hiddenPrefs.desc: His knees are finished and his daughter in Tucson has a spare room. He would rather sell at a fair number this year than a high one next.

intro: He brings a manila folder with every lease in it, typed, and a number he got by asking two friends at the Elks. "I don't know cap rates. I know what I put into it."

commercial.rentRoll: A cabinet shop, a brewery's barrel storage, an HVAC contractor and a man who restores pinball machines. Long leases, small rents, nobody behind.

issues.desc: Two bay doors off their tracks and chained shut
The sawtooth roof's gutters have rotted through over bays three and four
The brewery's lease lets it leave on ninety days' notice, and it has been looking at a building in Carver Mill
